_comment: KRONOS2 (MahmoodLab/KRONOS2 on HuggingFace) -- the authors' next-generation, marker-aware successor to KRONOS. Loaded via transformers.AutoModel (trust_remote_code), not the old 'kronos' pip package. No local marker_metadata.csv/model_assets needed -- the model ships its own 288-marker vocabulary and does its own marker-aware z-score via model.preprocess(). name_mappings here are ONLY for aliasing our marker names onto that vocabulary's naming, verified against the bundled marker_metadata.csv's own exact-match logic (marker_utils.marker_match_key), not invented.

immucan._comment_exclude_markers: DNA1/DNA2/HistoneH3 excluded for the same reason as every other method (nuclear/housekeeping stains, not phenotypic markers). CD33/Ecad/cleavedPARP additionally excluded because KRONOS2's marker-conditioning forward() (unlike its z-score preprocess() step) has NO fallback for an unmatched marker -- it hard-fails with 'No (fuzzy) match found', verified directly against model.backbone.marker_builder for all three. This means KRONOS2 sees 34 markers here, not KRONOS1's 37 -- a real, disclosed difference in available input, not a choice.
immucan._comment_name_mappings: Checked against KRONOS2's bundled marker_metadata.csv (288 markers) AND verified directly against model.backbone.marker_builder's real fuzzy matcher (not just the CSV lookup) for all six: SMA/GrzB/CD8a/TCF7/CD303/CarbonicAnhydrase have no match under their IMMUcan spelling but a confident biological-identity alias passes (A-SMA=SMA, GZMB=GrzB, CD8=CD8a, TCF1=TCF7 [same gene, alt name], BDCA-2=CD303 [same molecule], CA9=CarbonicAnhydrase IX).

chl._comment_patch_size: Same 64px as IMMUcan -- see kronos.json's cHL comment for the measured cell-footprint justification.
chl._comment_exclude_markers: Histone H3/SLP-76/anti-H2AX (pS139)/dsDNA/pSLP-76: same 5 excluded for every method on cHL (housekeeping/nuclear, not phenotypic). CD153 (CD30L) additionally excluded -- verified directly against the model's own marker_metadata.csv (288 rows): no row's marker_name OR marker_full_name matches CD153/CD30L/TNFSF8/'CD30 ligand' under any plausible spelling. RORgT was ALSO excluded here previously on the claim that the near-string vocabulary entry 'RORGD' had no evidence of being the same marker -- that claim was wrong: RORGD's own marker_full_name column (row 263) reads 'Retinoic acid-related orphan receptor gamma t', i.e. RORgammaT itself, and model.backbone.marker_builder._fuzzy_match(['RORGD']) succeeds (returns index 263). Fixed 2026-10 -- see name_mappings below. This means KRONOS2 sees 40 markers here, not 39.
chl._comment_name_mappings: Verified directly against model.backbone.marker_builder (both the real fuzzy matcher and, for RORgT, the model's own marker_full_name text): B2M, NAKATP, and RORGD all pass as exact vocabulary entries.
